messages:
maria: Opening a follow-up thread for the authz postmortem — last night we saw brief 401s from the token-auth service during peak churn and a correlated gap in the audit trail. Need owners, short fixes, and a long-term guard (alerts + runbook).

reno: I can take the client mitigation piece. Short-term: add 2 retry attempts with jitter and a client-side circuit breaker to avoid amplifying the load. I'll file INF-30001 and include a 48h canary plan. ETA Thu EOD.

sachi: I'll lead audit reliability. Root cause looks like the audit writer dropping events when its in-memory queue hit the cap under KV eviction storms. Plan: write-ahead buffer to local disk + metric dropped_audit_events_total + alert. Opening SRE-13000. ETA next Tue.

drew: Infra will tune cache and autoscaling. Proposal: bump hot-token TTL to 6m for frequently accessed tokens, and add a scale-up policy that triggers when miss_rate > 60% for 3m or when p95 latency > 120ms. I'll run staging chaos tests and post PR.

maria: Summarize actions so far:
- reno: INF-30001 - SDK retries + canary, due 2026-04-05
- sachi: SRE-13000 - write-ahead buffer + metric + alert, due 2026-04-06
- drew: infra PR - TTL + autoscale, due 2026-04-03
Add time estimates and deps please.

reno: dep: SDK release window + 48h canary; est 4 dev hrs + 2 QA hrs. Will attach rollout notes in the JIRA.

sachi: detection rule draft (PromQL style) — will translate to our alerting DSL:
```
expr: rate(audit_writer_written_total{job="token-auth",env="prod"}[15m]) < 0.2
for: 12m
labels: {severity: "warning", team: "sre"}
```
This flags sustained low write rates relative to baseline.

drew: repro note: used `wrk -t6 -c180 --timeout 5s` on staging against /validate to recreate cache churn + queue overflow. Logs attached to infra PR.

maria: Security check needed: ensure signing key and IAM role changes not involved. Carla out today — @sec-bot can you run the key/perm quick-scan and post results?

sec-bot: quick-scan started: checking signing key rotation timestamp, IAM role deltas in past 7 days, and deploys touching token-auth. Will post results in 10m.

sec-bot: quick-scan results: last signing key rotation 2025-08-03, no IAM role changes in last 7 days, two deploys to token-auth in the 24h window prior to the incident (deploy IDs: d-8291, d-8302). No immediate permissions drift found.

maria: Thanks. Two follow-ups: 1) add deploy tagging to the incident alert so we can correlate future spikes with recent deploys, 2) add a runbook step: when audit-write alert fires, temporarily freeze producer clients and enable local spillover. Can someone add those?

sachi: I'll add the runbook steps to SRE-13000 and implement the local spillover logic.

drew: I'll add deploy tagging to the alert dashboard and include deploy_id in the alert payload. Will include this in my infra PR.

reno: I'll make the SDK change feature-flagged so we can toggle quickly if we see problems in the canary.

maria: Recurrence detection: we saw a cluster of similar small blips in the past 6 weeks after high-traffic deploys. Let's add a monthly incident-pattern review to the postmortem playbook and a lightweight weekly digest that surfaces any authz 4xx spikes. Agree?

sachi: +1. I'll include a "pattern review" checklist item in the SRE runbook.

drew: +1. I'll add a dashboard tile that shows weekly 4xx spikes by deploy id.

sec-bot: scheduled recurring follow-up "authz-remediation-check" weekly on Mon 11:00 UTC for 4 weeks. Invites sent to maria, reno, sachi, drew.

maria: Closing criteria: 1) PRs merged and canary completed without regressions, 2) SRE alert in place and quiet for 48h, 3) runbook updated with pattern-review schedule. Please post PR/JIRA links and short updates here. We'll close thread when all met. :white_check_mark:
